evidence.quote: CertiFLY is currently being piloted at some airports and we look forward to expanding its use as traffic increases
TravelDoc, our automated document verification software, has been nominated as one of the key solutions to be used by the GHPC.
ICTS Europe will be supporting the project with our own products: SmartPoint and TravelDoc.
It is commercially available at various European and South African airports and is regularly used by leading airlines and freight forwarders, among them Air France and DHL.
